answer: Price every identity slot with a Harberger tax: each agent declares the value of its seat and pays a small continuous fee on it, while anyone may buy the seat at that price. A lone agent picks a modest value on its quiet knoll and pays little, but a sybil farmer must fund the same fee for every clone, and the fee anchors each identity to real ongoing cost. Honest agents keep their oasis of cheap participation, while a swarm's tax bill grows with each puppet until cloning stops paying.
